test.name: Lifestyle DNA Panel
test.description: Analyzes genetic variants associated with nutrition, physical performance, metabolism, and lifestyle traits to provide personalized insights into inherited predispositions.

test.name: Health Risk DNA Panel
test.description: Examines selected genetic variants associated with hereditary health conditions and disease susceptibility to identify potential genetic risk factors.

test.name: Pharmacogenetics Panel
test.description: Identifies genetic variations that may influence medication metabolism, treatment response, and adverse drug reactions to support personalized prescribing decisions.

test.name: Gut Microbiome Analysis
test.description: Analyzes the composition and diversity of intestinal microorganisms to provide insights into gut microbial balance and potential digestive health associations.

test.name: Oral Microbiome Analysis
test.description: Profiles microbial communities in the oral cavity to assess bacterial diversity and identify microorganisms associated with oral health conditions.

test.name: Targeted DNA PCR Test
test.description: Uses polymerase chain reaction to detect specific DNA sequences or genetic variants in a biological sample with high analytical sensitivity.

test.name: Vitamin D Blood Test
test.description: Measures blood levels of 25-hydroxyvitamin D to assess vitamin D status and help identify potential deficiency or excess.
